title: Commitment
tagline: Stake USDC on your GitHub commits. Ship or forfeit. Verified on-chain, no excuses.
description: Commitment is a Web3 accountability platform built for coding teams who want skin in the game. Teams create shared commitment pools, set GitHub commit targets, and stake USDC together. When the deadline hits, an AI agent autonomously queries the GitHub API to verify who actually shipped — no votes, no disputes, no human judgment. Members who hit their targets keep their stake and split any forfeited funds from those who didn't. Everything settles on Base L2 via smart contract, making the outcome transparent, tamper-proof, and automatic. Commitment turns the oldest problem in software — people not following through — into a self-enforcing system where accountability is baked into the protocol itself.
how_its_made: Smart contract on Base holds your team's USDC stakes. At deadline, an AI agent queries the GitHub API to verify each member's commits — no human judgment, no disputes, no excuses. Hit your target and keep your stake. Miss it and your funds automatically split to everyone who shipped. Dynamic handles wallet creation and social login so anyone can join without crypto experience, and Blink makes staking as easy as one tap. Code is the only proof that matters. Commit it. Prove it on-chain.
auto_summary: A web app and smart contract let teams stake funds on coding goals and settle payouts based on GitHub commit verification.
